title: Calibration labels from the furthest stage reached, read off the ledger
deviations_from_card: Write set SHRUNK: no app/_lib/calibration-outcome.ts leaf module. As a new module it measured +1 first-party module on ~20 task-hub/api routes whose module ceilings have zero headroom (group ceiling 229 and 13 overrides), so the pure calibrationOutcome() is exported from app/_lib/db/pipeline.ts instead (no new import edge, no ceiling raised). Its 8-row truth table and the 6 store cases live in one file, app/_lib/db/pipeline-calibration-furthest.test.ts (imports pipeline.ts under unit-db), not in a separate calibration-outcome.test.ts. The existing pipeline-calibration.test.ts / -band.test.ts needed no change (none of their fixtures move backward) and pass as they are. The docs commit (58ad3a155) landed first, alone under the lock, then the code+tests in one feat commit (f8208e021), so every commit is green. A test-only commit would have been red.
notes: Acceptance mapping: 1+2 (curve and drill both 1 after advance, no-show, reject), 5 (active moved back = 1), 7 (holdout composes) and 8 (pure truth table) were red at base; 3 (reject at gate = 0), 4 (stage_migrated-only = 0) and 6 (hire axis unchanged) were guards that already held. Before the change 3 of 8 acceptance cases passed. SQL is SELECT DISTINCT entry_id, to_stage FROM pipeline_events WHERE workspace_id=? AND kind!='stage_migrated' AND to_stage IN (positive ids), one read per call. Hire axis passes an empty positive set to that read, so it keeps the current-position rule. createPipelineEntry not touched. Gates: tsc is red only on foreign paths (untracked kpi-sim/, a sibling's accrual-horizon.test.ts, the sibling's in-flight app/api/status/[token]/resend route). Full test:unit had 3 failures, all from siblings' uncommitted files: public-body-cap-contract and route-capability-coverage come from the new untracked status/[token]/resend route, and analyticsRenderMap FLAKE from the untracked MetricPackPreview. My test files pass: furthest 14/14, calibration 6/6, band 3/3. perf: check-budget on a git-archive copy of base+my pipeline.ts, and again on committed HEAD f8208e021, shows no overage. The live checkout's KB overages come from siblings' uncommitted edits (group-eval-run.ts, metric-pack.ts, ...).
